title: Diffusion model guides identification of a candidate alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitor
summary: An E(3)-equivariant conditional diffusion model generated pocket-conditioned molecules aimed at secondary nucleation sites on alpha-synuclein fibrils, and purchasable analogues were selected and tested experimentally. One compound delayed alpha-synuclein aggregation under conditions where secondary nucleation dominates. The result is a candidate inhibitor shown in aggregation experiments only, with no reported cellular or in vivo testing in the abstract.
ai_technology: E(3)-equivariant conditional diffusion model generating pocket-conditioned molecules

evidence.tested: Selected compounds were tested in alpha-synuclein aggregation experiments dominated by secondary nucleation.
